in_marathi.name: Murari
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Beloved of God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Murari हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Murari is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'mur' meaning 'beloved'. This name is used to denote a devotee of Lord Vishnu or Rama. It is believed that Lord Rama was called Murari by his devotees, who were deeply devoted to him.
